scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n FRONT,BACK "bun run sv:dev" "bun run hono:dev"
scripts.sv:build: bun run sv:PreBuild && bun run sv:PostBuild
scripts.hono:dev: cd apps/hono && APP_ENV=development bun run dev
scripts.hono:generate: cd packages/db && bun x drizzle-kit generate
scripts.hono:migrate: cd packages/db && bun x drizzle-kit migrate
scripts.hono:push: cd packages/db && bun x drizzle-kit push
scripts.springkt:build: bun run springkt:PreBuild && bun run springkt:PostBuild
scripts.dotnet:PreBuild: cd apps/dotnetwebapi && dotnet publish -c Release -r linux-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:AssemblyName=serverDotnet -o ../../dist/dotnet
scripts.win64:PreBuild: cd wrappers/win64 && dotnet publish -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o ../../dist/wrapper-win64
scripts.android:PreBuild: cd wrappers/mobile && bun x cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:build: bun run android:PreBuild && bun run android:PostBuild
scripts.react:build: cd apps/react && bun run build --mode production
scripts.fast:dev: cd apps/fast && uv run python -m app.dev
scripts.fast:build: cd apps/fast && uv run python -m nuitka --onefile --standalone --output-filename=serverFast app/server.py
